summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) of the cipher-box project, which extracts cryptographic primitives and domain types from the desktop app into a Cargo workspace with separate crates.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (23-01: Cargo workspace + cipherbox-crypto crate) completed successfully. Wave 2 (23-02: cipherbox-core + 23-03: cipherbox-api-client) was spawned in parallel but the transcript ends before completion results are known.

repo: Phase 23 is on branch `feat/phase-23-rust-sdk-extraction` — branching strategy is 'phase' level
The project is structured as a Cargo workspace with crates under `crates/` directory
Crypto primitives extracted: AES-GCM, AES-CTR, ECIES, Ed25519, HKDF, IPNS name derivation — all in `crates/crypto/`
Domain types in scope for extraction: FolderMetadata, FileMetadata, RecycleBinMetadata, DeviceRegistry, vault blob v2, IPNS records
API client crate replaces hand-written HTTP code; inline hex constants move to JSON test vector files for cross-language Rust/TypeScript parity testing
workflow: GSD orchestrator uses wave-based parallel execution: plans are grouped into waves by dependency, agents within a wave run in parallel
Spot-checks after each wave verify SUMMARY.md existence, git commits matching the phase-plan pattern, and absence of `## Self-Check: FAILED` markers
Stale `_auto_chain_active` flag must be cleared at init when not invoked with `--auto` to prevent unwanted auto-advance from previous interrupted runs
Executor agents receive only file paths and read files themselves — keeps orchestrator context lean at ~10-15%

open_items: Wave 2 (23-02 cipherbox-core + 23-03 cipherbox-api-client) in-flight at transcript end — completion status unknown
Waves 3 and 4 not yet started: cipherbox-fuse, cipherbox-sdk, desktop thin shell cleanup, CI/release-please
Cross-language test vectors (JSON files from 23-03) will need validation against TypeScript implementation once crate is complete
